module_summary: AXI-lite read-channel register slice: with both reg types set to 1, the AR and R channels each pass through a simple single-entry register stage that inserts bubble cycles between slave and master ports.

anchors.name: genblk1.m_axil_araddr_reg
anchors.why: Registered read address forwarded from slave to master AR channel

anchors.name: genblk1.m_axil_arvalid_reg
anchors.why: AR register occupied/valid flag driving m_axil_arvalid

anchors.name: genblk1.s_axil_arready_reg
anchors.why: Registered AR ready, high when output buffer will be empty; gates capture

anchors.name: genblk1.store_axil_ar_input_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable capturing slave AR address into register

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axil_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Registered read data forwarded from master to slave R channel

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axil_rvalid_reg
anchors.why: R register valid flag driving s_axil_rvalid

anchors.name: genblk2.m_axil_rready_reg
anchors.why: Registered R ready toward master; gates data capture

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axil_r_input_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable capturing master read data into register

anchors.name: s_axil_rready
anchors.why: Slave read ready releasing R register

anchors.name: m_axil_arready
anchors.why: Master AR ready releasing AR register

groups.name: AR channel register
groups.description: Single-entry register slice on the read address channel

groups.name: R channel register
groups.description: Single-entry register slice on the read data channel
